0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 4-0 and first in the Northwest and in the West, visit the Houston Rockets, who are also 4-0, first in the Southwest and second in the West. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is without Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, with their last meeting coming on February 7, 2026 in Oklahoma City, where they lost 112-106.
